title: accept short term risk to develop horikita
context: Year 1 V5 actor goals and plans viewed through source-scoped temporal knowledge; normative evolution not automatic.
observed_actions: Privately wants Suzune to find the spy instead of changing a compromised roster, engineers a stern motivational challenge so she retrieves Sudō, and later predicts future strength despite foreseen poor festival results.
observed_result: Suzune changes course and Sudō returns, while Class D still places last; Kiyotaka withholds credit and misattributes planning to Suzune before Hirata.
epistemic_limits: The source establishes purposeful withholding of an immediate countermeasure, not a proved intention to make the class lose every event. No future unconditional sacrifice priority.
information_available: Private intent, public action and later retrospective statements stay in separate temporal lanes.
counterfactual_test: Under alternate incentives, trust and history, goal reprioritization is contingent, never pre-scripted.
